name: Walker Mari

intro.text: I am walking to Bala the way Mary Jones did. It is about twenty-five miles. She was fifteen, in 1800, and she did it on foot with a plan and no boots to speak of.

win: Right. That is a lesson in endurance. I am glad it was yours.
after: Twenty-five miles on foot for one book. It makes a late train look like a minor inconvenience.
